sort_runs.note: Added after the first sample as a popular listing (60K users, last update 2024-04). Recent sort only; the list ran out at 90 cards, so Helpful was not needed. Kept 4 negative, 2 mixed, 12 positive reviews; only 7 fall inside the 18-month window, so older reviews are tagged older-but-ongoing where the same request recurs.

reviews.text: Please add two keyboard shortcuts: one to translate the current web page to the default target language and one to display the page in its original format. This is a native Google Chrome feature that lacks keyboard controls.
Please add shortcut for "close all tabs to the right"
tags: feature request: close tabs to the right shortcut

reviews.text: I was looking to customize the shortcuts of Next Tab and Last Tab. This tool is very straightforward and easy to use.
tags: customize next and last tab shortcuts

reviews.text:
I really enjoy the app, the interface is great (built right into the settings). 

I wanted to use the go back to previous tab, and it doesn't work. I have messed with it 20 times, readjusted to a different "shortcut," and still nothing. It is unfortunate. 

There are a few other shortcuts that also don't work. The basics do, but I am bummed because I have used this many times on different profiles (different gmail accounts), but yep, can not figure it out.

Hi there, thank you for the wonderful extension! In the future, would it be possible to add a feature for a keybind that allows the user to switch to the "last active tab?"

For example, let's say I am on tab 2 and click on tab 8. Every time I press the hotkey chrome would switch between tab 8 and tab 2, regardless of their order up top.
can't set single key as shortcut

Works great, doesn't collect data on, has almost everything I need just wish there was a keybind to select the url, sometimes chrome lets you do it by pressing slash but only works when already searched something but wish there was a keybind that let you access the url bar whereever you are.
Great! I've always wanted to have a keyboard shortcut to duplicate the current tab.
Works great. I got used to ctrl-left/ctrl-right to select tabs, which I set up long back on another OS. So now Chrome does what I want.
Doesn't do much. I want to flip the action of J and K.

Awesome! ✨

Loved that it has 0 permissions required. 
I've seen other extensions that need to access my clipboard, cookies, downloads and more 🫨

This is nice for a select set of keyboard shortcuts.   No permissions needed, clear options, useful options I didn't know I needed.

The architecture does limit the options however, and there's one more that keyboard jockies would love.  A shortcut for "Create a new tab in current tab group" shortcut.   (May not be possible in this architecture though.  It's a menu item of the parent tab group only, mysteriously.)  I do not understand why this can't be done within chrome already.  Everybody seems to like to dump on tabgroups, but if you have lots of tabs open, it's a great way to organize tabs by function or by task, and then with the "Save Tab Group" toggle allow you to quickly switch between groups.  Create tab in current tab group shortcut is a vital enhancement for keyboard shortcut users to self organize tabs within tab groups, currently it's all drag and drop/menu item choices, not that slick...  (Shortcuts to activate a particular tab group would be nice, but next/previous group isn't quite as useful as click on button for a specific group.)
tags: feature request: new tab in current group

reviews.text: please support multiple modifiers instead of just 1. Would like to use "CTRL + ALT + Left/Right" to switch tabs
Does what exactly what's needed without needing any permissions. Google should pay the developer and integrate this natively. Thank you SO much.
1. Jump to previous tab and backwards like Alt+Tab? // 2.doesnt it show all existing keyboard shortcuts ???
Single key shortcuts not allowed .. eg prev tab -1, next tab-2, close tab -3, etc. Using them in Opera since many years, one of main reasons i use Opera.

Almoust the best extention! Dear devs, cld you add one more shortcut option for FIND (base Ctrl+F). I'm left-handed and I'd like to remap (Ctrl+F) to (Ctrl+ArrowDown) for my right hand and then I can paste (Shift+Insert) some text from the buffer then Enter and voila - very fast Find shortcut. 10x
